text_by_language.en: IMD Guwahati has issued forecast for Light to Moderate Rain with thunderstorm which is very likely to occur at a few places over Biswanath in next 2 hours. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
text_by_language.hi: Moderate Rain: IMD Guwahati has issued forecast for Light to Moderate Rain with thunderstorm which is very likely to occur at a few places over Biswanath in next 2 hours. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
